newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser-Busch 1996 beer sales up 4.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser-Busch 1996 beer sales up 4.1 pct.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc said on Thursday it sold a record 91.1 million barrels of beer in 1996, up 3.6 million barrels or 4.1 percent from 1995.
In 1995, Anheuser reduced wholesaler inventories by 1.1 million barrels at the end of 1995. Adjusting for that reduction, beer sales in 1996 were up 2.5 million barrels or 2.8 percent, it added.
Anheuser said this increase in beer sales boosted its U.S. market share to more than 45 percent, a full point increase in market share. No further market share data were available.
Citing industry sales estimates, the company said it widened its sales lead over other major brewers, "all of whom lost market share in 1996," it said.
Industry beer sales grew about one percent, or a little less than two million barrels in 1996, the company said, citing Beer Institute estimates.
"We've got great momentum heading into 1997," August Busch III, chairman of the board, said in a statement.
Anheuser-Busch, which brews 30 beer brands including the top two in the United States, Budweiser and Bud Light, said it will report fourth quarter and full-year 1996 results next month.
